verdict.rationale: OpenCode is an AI coding agent whose core function is producing AI analysis of the user's own data, their codebase. The plan agent is documented to "analyze code, suggest changes, or create plans" without modifying files, and a read-only explore agent is provided for investigating codebases. missing for 10: evidence of insights over non-code data (e.g., logs, analytics, business data), independent hands-on corroboration of insight/suggestion quality specifically, detail on how insights are surfaced beyond chat output.
